newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorco Manitoba workers vote Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Minorco Manitoba workers vote Tuesday.

text.p: The majority of workers at Minorco SA's Hudson Bay Mining and Smelting Co Ltd in northern Manitoba will vote on a new contract on Tuesday, a company spokeswoman said on Monday.
Workers represented by the United Steelworkers and a group of trade unions will vote tomorrow but results will not be available until late in the day or on Wednesday, the spokeswoman said.
About 250 workers represented by a mechanics' union have not yet concluded negotiations with the company, she said. The union and company will go to conciliation on March 4.
The last contract with the zinc and copper operation's 2,100 employees ended October 1. Copper production from the smelter was 74,000 tonnes in 1995. Zinc production was 93,000 tonnes in 1995.
